_description: One row per SEC filing that contains a process signal for a tracked case. A single company case typically generates 2–10 filing events across its lifecycle. Normalized from the company-level case.

event_id.description: Unique filing event ID. Extends case_id with sequential EV suffix.

case_id.description: Foreign key to cases.csv. One case has many events.

ticker.description: Stock ticker. Redundant with case_id for query convenience.

filing_date.description: Date the filing was submitted to SEC EDGAR. This is the event's t=0 for transition detection.

filing_type.description: SEC form type. Must match EDGAR classification.

accession_number.description: SEC EDGAR accession number. Primary key for retrieving the filing programmatically. Format: CIK-YY-SEQUENCE.

source_url.description: Direct EDGAR filing index URL. Format: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/{CIK}/{accession}/

event_type.description: Classification of what process signal this filing contains.

process_state_before.description: Process state immediately before this filing was detected.

process_state_after.description: Process state assigned after this filing is incorporated.

is_escalation.description: True if this filing moves process_state to a higher rank (stronger evidence). SCREENING→LIVE = escalation.

is_downgrade.description: True if this filing moves process_state to a lower rank.

signal_quality.description: signal_quality value the scanner assigns based on this filing.

item4_intent.description: For SC 13D filings: Item 4 intent classification from item4_parser logic. NOT_APPLICABLE for non-13D filings.

item4_intensity.description: Item 4 intensity as classified by item4_parser scoring.

item4_confidence_score.description: Numeric confidence score from item4_parser (0–100). Null for non-13D filings.

excerpt.description: Key excerpt from the filing text that triggered this event classification. Must be verbatim from filing.

triggering_phrases.description: Pipe-separated list of specific phrases from the filing that contributed to classification. E.g., 'explore a sale|maximize shareholder value'.

downgrade_phrases.description: Pipe-separated list of hedging phrases detected (e.g., 'no assurance|from time to time|may consider').

activist_filer.description: For SC 13D filings: name of the activist filer. Null for non-13D.

activist_ownership_pct.description: For SC 13D: percent ownership disclosed at time of filing.

days_since_prior_event.description: Calendar days since the previous filing event in this case. Null for first event.

days_since_case_start.description: Calendar days from case first_observation_date to this filing.

notes.description: Free-text annotation. Anything unusual, ambiguous, or needing follow-up.
